comments.author: @CathyCrawford-l7w
comments.text:
The photography in this documentation is so incredibly beautiful!!!   I've seen many documentaries but this by far the absolute best.  The music that accompanied the scenery was relaxing & well chosen.  The people seem happy.  I appreciated the culture displays with dancing & craft making.  In my opinion this is one of the BEST!  Thank you 😊 for taking me on this journey!  It was incredible & I didn't have to get out of my favorite chair.  Time for another cup of coffee ☕️.
& finding the next documentary.  It will take alot to be as wonderful as this one 😊🎉.
From Grover, North Carolina USA
